risks.mitigation: Use factual alt text, visible conceptual-image captions where appropriate, and adjacent project copy; never describe contextual or synthetic imagery as literal evidence from the represented work.

Keep synthetic disclosure visible and consistent; prohibit fabricated readable text, interfaces, metrics, testimonials, facilities, staff identities, and outcome claims. Sustainable-abundance imagery must not imply a real kingXford & Co facility, staff, project, or measured result.
Use optimized local WebP plates, CSS/Motion transforms, native scroll, and a reduced-motion static path.
Deploy and verify the Vercel production URL; treat custom-domain DNS as a separate owner-controlled configuration.

Record reference and publication years, retain official links and interpretation boundaries beside every visual, and re-verify figures before a dated article update rather than silently replacing values.
